title: Audit Release workspace — baseline, gaps, and questions
goal: Audit the Release area to gather a baseline understanding: what exists today, what the area is trying to build, and what is missing/incomplete/needs improvement. Use deep research and sequential thinking; finish with prioritized questions for the owner to answer on how to build or fix each gap. Focus: CI, deployment, environment validation, observability, cron, and release readiness

in: docs/engineering/agents/release/ — charter, state, architecture, backlog, interfaces, decisions, verification, working set
The release default paths declared in WORKING_SET.json
docs/engineering/generated/ — routes, api-routes, components, database-schema, permissions, integrations maps
docs/work-packets/ — existing bounded work packets for this area
.agents/ legacy specialist ledgers that document this area
out: Production code and migration changes (this is a read-only audit)
docs/admin-audit remediation stream unless findings directly affect this domain
Agent registry, task model, and opencode agent definitions

acceptance_criteria: Baseline produced as docs/engineering/agents/release/BASELINE.md: what the release area contains today (routes, components, services, API routes, database objects, tests, evidence), each claim backed by a real path reference; plus the area's intended direction, cited to docs/DEVELOPMENT_BACKLOG.md, docs/work-packets/, docs/engineering/agents/release/BACKLOG.md, and relevant specs.
Started from the domain working set and a packet built via npm run agents:context -- --task RELEASE-001; expanded scope only on evidence, with the path and reason recorded in a checkpoint.

Used deep research and sequential thinking to identify everything that is missing, incomplete, or needs improvement; recorded as docs/engineering/agents/release/GAPS.md, every item triaged (missing / incomplete / improve) with evidence and location.

Produced docs/engineering/agents/release/QUESTIONS.md: a prioritized list of questions to the product owner explaining how to build or fix each gap (build vs fix vs drop and sequencing); the questions are also surfaced in the final checkpoint summary.
Updated docs/engineering/agents/release/STATE.md (working / partial / broken / focus) and BACKLOG.md to reflect the baseline findings.
No production code or migration files changed; this is a read-only audit task (qa/release additionally honor their edit: deny permission).
npm run agents:validate passes with 0 errors before completion.
The task is not blocked on unanswered questions; owner answers become follow-up task records owned by this agent.

checkpoints.summary: RELEASE-001 audit completed. Top-5 prioritized owner questions: Q1 prod/demo env split + PITR/restore drill + complete Vercel env (FIX, WS-0.6/G2); Q2 Sentry DSNs (web+mobile) + uptime monitoring + alert routing + SLOs for auth/checkout/stream (BUILD, WS-1.4/G4); Q3 make e2e.yml a required check + burn down 27 vitest failures + typecheck budget (FIX, WS-1.6/G3); Q4 schedule event-reminders stub + register MV refresh via pg_cron + resolve 16-vs-21 music outbox workers + cron/worker monitoring (BUILD, WS-1.5/G5); Q5 enable RATE_LIMIT_ENFORCE with real Upstash + prod rate-limit smoke (FIX, WS-1.3/G6). Gap tally: 16 total — 5 MISSING (G-01 Sentry observability, G-02 uptime/SLO/alerting, G-07 MV refresh pg_cron, G-09 Docker CI, G-11 release architecture/decisions/backlog), 7 INCOMPLETE (G-03 prod/PITR/drill, G-04 e2e required+CI green, G-05 rate limiting inactive, G-06 event-reminders stub unscheduled, G-08 music workers not scheduled + 16-vs-21 count, G-10 legacy deploy surface drift, G-12 perf metrics log-only), 4 IMPROVE (G-13/G-14/G-15/G-16). Blocking-for-other-agents: none hard; WS-1.6 remaining vitest failures depend on product/schema decisions owned by other domains; WS-1.5 event-reminders + worker deployment may need a database/integrations handoff. Confirmed no production code changes.
